answer: Use pseudonym-party signing circles, with no stake. 1) Each epoch, people join a randomized 20-minute physical meeting and scan its QR nonce. 2) Each creates one key before two neighbors; witnesses sign only keys seen, capped at eight each. 3) A blinded nullifier enters the public atlas, giving one anonymous ballot per attendee; any delta beyond a witness’s cap voids that batch. 4) Witnesses rotate each epoch. For 100 extra votes, an attacker needs 100 attendees at $30 each, a $200 venue, and two hours: $3,200 per epoch. It is like counting yarrow by living plants, not photocopied leaves.
